test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the sex ratio of India as per 2011 census?
solution: The correct answer is **__943.__** __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** • The** sex ratio** is defined as the ratio of women per thousand males. • According to the population census of 2011, the sex ratio of India is **943 females per thousand males.** • Census 2011 is indeed an upward trend as in census 2003 it was **933 females per thousand males.**
